about.title: Built for sun-baked land, like the acacia.
about.text: The acacia thrives where little else does: strong roots, little water, full sun. That is how we work. Acacia Engineering is a Jaipur team of solar engineers who size every system to your actual bill, install it cleanly, and keep it producing.
